from collections import Counter
def solve(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); c0=min(p[1] for p in pts)
    r1=max(p[0] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    m=[[bg if (i,j) not in set(pts) else I[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    mh,mw=len(m),len(m[0]); o=2*max(mh,mw)+2
    # center: demo 4x4->10x10, so offset max(0, -((o-mh)*?)) hmm compute offsets from demo
    return m
m=solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])
print(len(m),len(m[0]))
print([[c for c in r]+[0]*(10-len(r)) for r in [[2*c for c in rr]+[0]*(8-len(rr)) for rr in r]] for r in m])
